search_files.desc: Find files or directories by name/path using glob patterns or Go regex. Use when you know part of a filename, extension, or relative path; use grep_files when you need to search file contents.

params.path: Root directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory. Must be a directory.
params.pattern: Glob or regex pattern. Glob patterns without / match basenames; patterns with / or ** match relative paths.
params.max_results: Maximum matching paths to return. Default: 100. Non-positive values keep the default.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files/directories whose names start with '.'. Default: false.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Regex patterns without / match basenames; regex patterns with / match relative paths. Default: false.
params.case_insensitive: Case-insensitive matching for glob or regex mode. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Basename globs to prune before matching, such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files.
params.output_mode: "paths" (default) returns concise paths; "details" adds entry type, size, and modified time.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root; "absolute" returns absolute paths.
params.entry_type: "any" (default), "file", or "dir". Invalid values fall back to any.

grep_files.desc: Search text file contents for literal text or Go regex. Use for symbols, strings, config keys, and errors. Binary files are skipped and reported; output_mode controls whether you get matching lines, files, or counts.

params.path: File or directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.pattern: Literal text by default, or a Go regular expression when use_regex=true. Required.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Required for regex operators such as |, ., *, +, ^, $, groups, or character classes. Default: false.
params.recursive: Search subdirectories when path is a directory. Default: true.
params.context_lines: Lines before and after each match in content/auto modes. Default: 0; maximum: 50.
params.max_results: Maximum matches per page for content/auto modes. Default: 50. Non-positive values keep the default.
params.offset: Skip this many collected matches in content/auto modes for pagination. Default: 0.
params.glob: Only search files whose basename matches this glob, such as *.go or *.{ts,tsx}. Strongly prefer setting this in large projects.
params.output_mode: "auto" (default) shows matching lines when uncapped, then falls back to file list when capped; "content" always shows lines; "files_with_matches" returns paths; "count" returns per-file counts.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files and directories. Default: false.
params.multiline: Allow matches to span lines. Uses full-file reads for eligible text files, so combine with glob/max_file_size on large trees. Default: false.
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 0 (no size limit). Use this for large repos with logs, exports, databases, or generated files.
params.exclude_patterns: Basename globs to prune before searching, such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, logs, or generated files.
params.path_format: "relative" (default) returns paths relative to the search root; "absolute" returns absolute paths.
